title: Limits to Arbitrage and Commodity Index Investment: Front-Running the Goldman Roll
summary: Scheduled index maturity-roll spreads; source rejects a simple modern livestock extrapolation.
about: Short index-held delivery month and buy destination month ahead of scheduled rolls.
findings: Author Table IV A livestock Strategy1: 4.99% annual excess return, Sharpe1.67 in2000–March2010. Source also reports post2006 decay and negative livestock averages since2008; measured costs omitted. Not independently replicated.
mechanism: Predictable index demand against limited arbitrage capital; the source itself discusses crowding and migration to other index designs.
build_on: Do not test the published protocol as a current livestock candidate. Overnight holding conflicts with Apex scope; current personal merit and matched data/costs not established. Retain failure evidence; no rescue adaptation.
source_revision: 2011-07-15 CFTC-hosted46-page source; parity with other SSRN revisions unknown
full_text_read_scope: Connected full-PDF source review of main methods, relevant rules/results, costs, conclusions and key tables; scope detailed in linked review; no independent raw-data replication.
